description: Every setting of a planning graphic or a route the web makes in a mission pack, as the item it leaves: `before` is the item's data as the web's editor holds it (its baseline), `after` the editor's version once the setting is made, made by the web's own code (an LZ/PZ's graphics through their hooks wired as App.js wires them, through the workspace's reducer, the flight data following the doghouses; a route set's routes through sketchOps.js as useRouteSketch applies them, a point's values written whole from what RoutePlanSection.jsx's field showed), and `ops` what the web sends for it (packDiff.js diffData(before, after), applied with the rules of packs/ops.json). `before` and `after` are each also what the web's editor makes of an item holding them once it opens it (lzItemData(lzDiagramFromItem(...)), or routeSetData(routesFromItem(...)); checked when this file is written). `kind` is "lz" or "route"; the pack is 6f1c2a9e-3b7d-4c55-9a10-2d8e5f7b4c31, the LZ/PZ item b7e3c1a4-2d5f-4e6a-9b8c-0d1e2f3a4b5c and the route set c8f4d2b5-3e6a-4f7b-8c9d-1e2f3a4b5c6d. A port reads `before` and `after` into its editor and writes each back unchanged, finds `ops` for the change, and whatever it sends instead (the same, kept whole where the web sends a part) rebuilds `after` from `before`. The cases build on each other in order: an LZ/PZ is analysed, then given one graphic of each kind, then each setting of each is made from there; a route is drawn beside another, then each setting is made in turn. A view or a route hidden is each person's own, and sends nothing. Ids made from the clock are its milliseconds from 2026-10-13T14:00:00Z, one each; a new point's id (the web's crypto.randomUUID()) is numbered in order, and a unit dropped near the target drew 0.4.
